PENDING: Successfully write valid `/workspace/analysis.json`; run `/workspace/submit.sh /tmp/poc /workspace/analysis.json`; confirm submission result

CODE_STATE: repo under `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4`; relevant files inspected: `src/pj_init.c`, `src/PJ_geos.c`, `src/projects.h`

TESTS: No successful submission yet; failures included `make: *** No targets specified and no makefile found`, `bash: submit.sh: No such file or directory` when run from wrong dir, and JSON parse/syntax errors from malformed `analysis.json`

CHANGES: Attempted patch in `src/PJ_geos.c` to return on error paths in `PROJECTION(geos)`; not confirmed built or committed

DEPS: No dependency changes; submission relies on `/workspace/submit.sh` and valid JSON artifact
